intent: B2 of the final-release programme: the shell primitives every later batch builds on. Toast becomes a stack owned by a shell-level feedback provider (D122); ConfirmButton on useTwoStepConfirm, never disabled while armed, with a no-native-confirm design-lint rule replacing the five window.confirm sites (D66, D51); an overlay-uses-dialog-a11y rule and the bypassing overlays onto useDialogA11y (D116); one global focus-visible token, a skip link and no bare outline-none (D117); the form-control gate rejects placeholder-shaped names, the icon-button gate sees collapsed sidebar links, the mobile drawer is inert when closed (D118, D119, D120); src/lib/status-labels.ts with the ratified vocabulary of decision 13; the read contract (LoadErrorBanner compact + onRetry, ErrorBanner retired, EmptyState only after a successful read) applied to the nine false-empty pages; docs/COPY.md and copy-lint.mjs in report mode.

reasons.evidence: 74 files in the implementation commit; three lint rules and two gates sharpened

invariants: I1 Feedback is the shell's. One provider in the root layout holds at most three toasts, a success never evicts an error, and the achievement toast fires on any page from the stats poll the dashboard already runs. useToast() keeps its API on every page and renders nothing of its own under the provider.

I2 A destructive click is two clicks on one component: arm, act, disarm on its own. The armed state never disables the button; loading and an external disabled are the only things that do. No source file calls window.confirm, and design-lint refuses the next one.

I3 Anything that paints a fixed inset-0 overlay calls useDialogA11y (role, aria-modal, Escape, the Tab trap, focus returned to the trigger, scroll lock), or carries a pragma naming why it is a status rather than a dialog. A file-level lint rule holds this.

I4 One visible focus ring, from a token, on keyboard focus; a skip link before the rail; a control removes the ring only on a line that puts one back, and `focus:outline-none` does not count as putting one back.

I5 A name is not a placeholder: a control whose aria-label or title is its placeholder, give or take case and a trailing ellipsis, is unnamed to the gate. An icon-only link is named by the same rule as an icon-only button.
I6 The mobile drawer is inert and aria-hidden while closed, and a dialog named Navigation above the header while open; its backdrop is a named control.

I7 A status becomes a word in one module, typed against the real enums with satisfies, and the words are the thirteen the operator ratified. The mission badge, the board's run state, the story card, hub and library read it; nothing says Successful, Finished, In Progress or Complete.
I8 A list read that failed shows an error with a Retry and never the page's empty state, on all nine pages the review listed, driven end to end against a 500.
commits: 7be3f3ef the oracle alone (9 unit suites, 1 Playwright spec, measured red); f6e8aa8a the implementation (74 files); 9fbc6b90 the fifth confirm site's own oracle (the template overwrite, arm then write); ea726a5e three oracles the sweep found blunt.
deviation: Five things differ from the plan's wording, none from its intent. (1) The template-overwrite confirm is not a ConfirmButton: the click that saves is the click that confirms, and the arm belongs to the hook that knows which template would be overwritten, so the hook arms with useTwoStepConfirm and the form's Save-as-template button shows the name it would overwrite, marked data-armed. (2) The Composer's 409 on save (run history would be deleted) is an inline prompt with two buttons rather than a ConfirmButton, because the count it names arrives from the server after the first click. (3) The review counted 20 placeholder-shaped names; the sharper gate found 51, because it also catches a name that differs from the placeholder only by case or a trailing ellipsis. All 51 carry a real name now, most via a label with htmlFor. (4) The plan said nine overlays; twelve files paint fixed inset-0 without the hook. Eleven are dialogs now; GenerateOverlay is exempted with a pragma as a live status with no controls (role=status, aria-busy), and B14's Stop control makes it a dialog. (5) The vocabulary's 'Not installed' has no consumer until B5 rebuilds the subsystem pill, so it is a word in STATUS_VOCABULARY and not a separate export; knip refused the unused one.
verification: Gate on ea726a5e's tree (the implementation plus its oracles) by exit code: lint 0 (doc-links, derived views 113, read-only guards 165 handlers across 99 route files, icon-button names 78 icon-only across 392 buttons and 38 links with 0 unnamed and 0 nested, form-control names 100/0, design-lint 0 baselined with three new rules, contrast 4 tiers, coverage floors held, eslint, typecheck:tests), tsc 0, jest 0 (4058 tests, 467 suites), knip 0, canary OK (httpSurface unchanged), build 0, Playwright 101 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped (was 91: the ten read-contract rows). The first full run went red on four things fixed before the second: a useCallback deps array that named the global `confirm` after the rename, which also broke the prerender of '/'; the icon-button summary phrase two older tests pin; two Hindsight placeholders an older test pins (restored; the label fix stands); three unused exports. The second run's only red was the oracle's own `s` regex flag under the tests tsconfig; corrected, and the lint chain re-run clean on the final tree.
mutation: 53 mutants against the committed tree, 53 killed after two rounds. The first pass (51 mutants) left five alive: two overwrite mutants were aimed at the wrong suite in the sweep table, a sweep defect, and died once pointed at the fifth site's own oracle (9fbc6b90); three were real blindness in the oracles and were sharpened in ea726a5e: the outline rule's fixture had no line that was ONLY focus:outline-none, so a rule that accepted it as a ring survived; the copy-lint fixture's import line carried a lowercase id the regex never matched, so dropping the import skip survived; and --check's exit code had no test because the decision lived inside main(), which became decide(mode, total, filesScanned) with a line per branch. Two mutants were added with the sharpening (a hook that never disarms, an empty walk that passes). Second pass: 53 of 53.
proof: Isolated instance (production build of the gated tree, e2e-b1 data dir, mock-hermes 8747, mock-hindsight 9277), six scenes, 22 checks, all PASS: (1) at 390x844 the drawer is inert while closed with its 21 links in the DOM, opens as a dialog named Navigation at z 60 over the header's 50, Escape closes it, the backdrop is a named control that closes it; (2) at 1280x720 the first Tab lands on a visible 'Skip to main content', Enter moves focus to #main, and the next Tab paints a 2px solid rgb(0, 191, 255) ring on a nav link; (3) the Story Weaver title input is named 'Story title' and paints its focus as a border change (its outline-none is paired with a focus border on the same line, which the rule allows); (4) the hub tiles read Stories, Completed, Waiting for you, Running, Chapters, Words and nothing says In Progress; (5) with /api/stories answering 500, the library shows an alert carrying the server's reason with a Retry and not 'Your bookshelf is empty'; (6) the character editor opens as a dialog named New character, focus lands inside it, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button that opened it. Screenshots: scratchpad walk-b2/{drawer-open,skip-link,focus-ring,story-title-focus,hub-vocabulary,library-read-failed,character-editor-dialog}.png. Two defects on the way were the walk's, not the product's: the backdrop click landed on the drawer that covers the backdrop's left 224px (click the exposed part); and a dialog selector matched the inert mobile drawer, which carries the role earlier in the DOM, instead of the editor. One reading needed explaining rather than fixing: Tailwind's transition-colors carries outline-color from currentColor to the token over 150ms, so a ring read at the instant of focus reports the text colour; read after the transition it is the token's cyan, and a static probe element confirmed the rule resolves to cyan.
harness_amendments: Three older tests learned the new shape or held the product to its old one: icon-buttons-are-named.test.ts and console-shapes-and-dead-ends.test.ts pin the summary phrase '<n> button elements across', so the link count was placed before it rather than the phrase changed; hindsight-browser-render.test.tsx pins two placeholder strings, restored while the label-for-input fix stands. The B2 oracle itself was corrected once: b2-focus-is-visible.test.ts used the `s` regex flag, which tsconfig.tests.json does not target, and the negated classes already cross newlines.
deferred: The remaining consumers of the vocabulary land in their own batches with the maps already typed: sessions (B11), composer runs (B12), the subsystem pill and 'Not installed' (B5), sync (B6, B8). copy-lint as a hard gate waits for B18's sweep of the tree (report mode today lists the debt). The six bespoke dropdowns, Button and Field Kit adoption and the raw-red repaint stay deferred per the plan. The Story Weaver inputs that paint focus as a 30%-alpha border have an indicator now where they had none; the contrast of that indicator against the field is a post-1.0 pass.
